brief.title: observatory-mediawiki: 7-gap improvement run
brief.description: Run down all 7 gaps from improvement-spec.md. Central decision: Gap 7 (gomplate adoption) drives the shape of the whole pipeline — specifically Gaps 1 and 2. We reason it out explicitly in Step 3 and commit to a path before any template or CI work begins. All implementation flows from that decision.

steps.title: Verify Gap 3: DockerSettings.php is COPYd into image
steps.instruction:
Run: docker run --rm ghcr.io/phosphene/observatory-mediawiki:main-dev grep -c 'EditNotify' /var/www/mediawiki/w/DockerSettings.php
If count > 0: Gap 3 RESOLVED — conf/DockerSettings.php IS the baked file. Mark COMPLETE.
If count == 0: Gap 3 REAL — COPY step not picking up our conf/ version. Mark FAILED.

steps.title: Gap 4: Add 11 Observatory extensions to DOCKER_EXTENSIONS
steps.instruction: Edit conf/DockerSettings.php — add to DOCKER_EXTENSIONS array: EditNotify, EmailPage, JavascriptSlideshow, Matomo, PageMagic, PageNotice, PdfBook, RSS, SearchThumbs, ShortDescription (VipsScaler already present). Also add runtime-mounted extensions for documentation: MixedNamespaceSearchSuggestions, CategoryLockdown, CiteDrawer. Commit to feat/improvement-run-2026-06-25.

steps.title: Gap 5: Remove stale apache-mediawiki.conf
steps.instruction: Verify: grep -r 'apache-mediawiki.conf' Dockerfile — should return nothing. If unreferenced: delete conf/apache-mediawiki.conf. If referenced: fix content to match conf/mediawiki.conf instead. Commit to feat/improvement-run-2026-06-25.

steps.title: Gap 7: Gomplate adoption — reason it out and commit the decision
steps.instruction:
Write docs/gomplate-decision.md. Choose Path A (adopt gomplate) or Path B (stay static).

REASONING:
1. conf/composer.wikiteq.json.tmpl already exists in this repo — gomplate is half-started.
2. The Dockerfile has 145+ extensions across 6 stages. Each addition requires manually    syncing Dockerfile RUN block AND DOCKER_EXTENSIONS. Gomplate does both atomically.
3. values.schema.json exists upstream — schema validation is free once adopted.
4. The 11 Observatory extensions from Step 1 are the exact use case gomplate solves.
5. values.yml bootstrap from current Dockerfile is one-time ~2h work.

If Path A: include bootstrap plan (how to extract values.yml from current Dockerfile). If Path B: document compensating controls.

Commit docs/gomplate-decision.md to feat/improvement-run-2026-06-25.

steps.title: Gap 6: Merge fix/chameleon-v1-parity
steps.instruction: Create PR from fix/chameleon-v1-parity → main on phosphene/observatory-mediawiki. Use GitHub app token (PEM: meta/github-app-temporal.pem, installation 141959311). Merge after CI passes. Output: PR URL + merge SHA.

steps.title: Gap 1a+1b: CI Layer 1 — static validation gate
steps.instruction:
Read steps/03-gomplate-decision.md for chosen path. Add 'validate' job to .github/workflows/build-push.yml before 'build'.
ALL PATHS: php -l conf/DockerSettings.php, python3 -m json.tool composer.local.json, hadolint Dockerfile.
PATH A ONLY: ./validate.sh, gomplate dry-run diff vs snapshot.
PATH B ONLY: DOCKER_EXTENSIONS completeness script.
BOTH: Path B symlink assertions post-build.
Commit to feat/improvement-run-2026-06-25.

steps.title: Gap 1b: CI Layer 2 — snapshot test job
steps.instruction: Add 'snapshot-test' job after 'build', before 'push'. Diffs baked DockerSettings.php and composer.local.json vs source. Runs settings validation gate: php /getMediawikiSettings.php --version MediaWiki. PATH A: also diff rendered composer.wikiteq.json vs golden master. Commit to feat/improvement-run-2026-06-25.

steps.title: Gap 1c: Port BDD compliance suite to observatory-mediawiki
steps.instruction: Copy observatory-magazine-v2/tests/compliance/ to tests/compliance/ in this repo. Adjust: go.mod module path, docker-compose.yml to use this image directly, README paths. Add 'compliance' job to build-push.yml after 'snapshot-test', before 'push'. Commit to feat/improvement-run-2026-06-25.

steps.title: Final: create PR + trigger image build
steps.instruction: Create PR feat/improvement-run-2026-06-25 → main on phosphene/observatory-mediawiki. Title: 'feat: 7-gap improvement run — CI pipeline, extensions, gomplate decision'. Body summarises all gap outcomes. Use GitHub app token. Output: PR URL.
